name: Kitzbüheler Horn
kurzbeschreibung: The Kitzbüheler Horn (1,996 m) is Kitzbühel's iconic panoramic mountain, celebrated for the KitzSki gondolas, the Alpine Flower Garden, and 360-degree vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The commanding summit of the Kitzbüheler Horn (1,996 metres) presides directly over the world-renowned alpine haven of Kitzbühel, standing proudly opposite the fabled Hahnenkamm ridge. Instantly recognized by its broadcast tower perched on the limestone summit pyramid, the Horn delivers one of Austria's finest 360-degree panoramas, spanning the jagged Wilder Kaiser, the Hohe Tauern peaks including Großglockner and Großvenediger, and the distant Zillertal Alps. The mountain is internationally acclaimed for hosting Austria's premier high-altitude botanical reserve: the 'Alpine Flower Garden Kitzbüheler Horn' spans over 20,000 square metres at 1,880 metres altitude, sheltering more than 400 rare alpine botanical species from mountain ranges across the globe. Modern gondolas transport sightseers right to the crest, establishing the Horn as a premier excursion mountain.

Route & Anforderungen

Hiking tracks on the Kitzbüheler Horn range from leisurely nature walks to demanding vertical ascents. Departing from the summit cableway terminal, the geological Karst Trail weaves through weathered limestone fissures and sinkholes in roughly 45 minutes of easy walking. Exploring the botanical flower garden takes roughly 30 minutes on crushed gravel footpaths. Sporty trekkers can hike all the way from the valley floor in Kitzbühel or St. Johann up to the summit cross (approx. 3.5 hours, 1,200 vertical metres). Comfortable walking shoes suffice for the flower garden and summit crest; rugged ankle-high boots with Vibram tread are necessary for descent trails across alpine pastures.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via highway B161 or B170 into Kitzbühel, following signs to the Hornbahn valley station on the northeastern fringe of town (generous free parking provided). Alternatively, a paved scenic toll road ascends to the Alpenhaus inn at 1,670 metres. Train passengers disembark at Kitzbühel main station or Hahnenkamm station.

Tipps

Visit the Alpine Flower Garden during peak bloom between late June and early August to witness edelweiss, gentians, and alpine roses in full splendor. Conclude your day on the sun terrace of the Hornköpflhütte savoring Tyrolean delicacies facing the Großglockner.
preis: Trails and Alpine Flower Garden freely accessible; KitzSki cable cars apply passenger fares
oeffnungszeiten: Summer cable car operations run daily mid-May to early November
